steps: Install Claude Code from its website
Come back and press Check again
Sign in from the Claude card in a new chat
Run codex once to sign in
Pick a model provider in OpenCode

chapters.title: Ask for three things at once
chapters.caption: Say what you want. Neyvia keeps a checklist, runs the tools and shows each step, on the model you pick.

chapters.title: LAYA looks at your apps
chapters.caption: LAYA is Neyvia's own eye. It reads the screen of an app a model is building or using, so the model can fix what it cannot see in code.

chapters.title: Manuals that run
chapters.caption: A manual is a procedure Neyvia can execute and check, not a page of advice. Each step ends in a pass or a fail you can open.

chapters.title: One mission, several providers
chapters.caption: Split a goal across Claude Code, Codex and Neyvia's own agent. Each task keeps its model, its receipts and its place in the plan.

chapters.title: Claude Code, on your plan
chapters.caption: Neyvia starts Claude Code itself, so your plan and your sign-in stay yours. The Neyvia mod adds its tools and live status, and any session can open in a terminal.

chapters.title: Neyvia skills inside Codex
chapters.caption: Codex gets Neyvia's skills for PDFs, images and design. Neyvia only adds folders it marks, and never touches yours.

chapters.title: Watch an agent work
chapters.caption: Open Agents at work to see an agent's desktop live, then replay a finished run with its receipts.

chapters.title: Everything one key away
chapters.caption: Press Ctrl Space for apps, chats and actions. Type to find anything.

chapters.title: Projects and changes
chapters.caption: The Workspace panel shows the branch and every file an agent changed. Open one to see its diff.

chapters.title: Follow a mission in detail
chapters.caption: Follow agent tasks and their receipts. Provider access, permissions and approvals still apply.

chapters.title: App Factory frames
chapters.caption: Build and preview app frames in App Factory. Running and exporting an app needs its actual files, toolchain and permissions.

chapters.title: Read and search PDFs
chapters.caption: Open a PDF next to the chat. You and the agent see the same page and the same highlights.

chapters.title: Local streaming dictation
chapters.caption: Speak into a note or chat. Text arrives as you talk; local engine status and any fallback stay visible.

chapters.title: 3D Studio and editors
chapters.caption: Use Browser 3D or connect Unity, Roblox, Godot and Blender. Each connector shows its real setup and session status.

chapters.title: Images and live preview
chapters.caption: Open Image Studio to generate with a configured provider, inspect the live preview, edit pixels and export. Generation needs provider access.

chapters.title: Live mobile preview
chapters.caption: Preview a web app in phone frames. Native builds require the matching toolchain and your signing setup.

chapters.title: Your PC from your phone
chapters.caption: Open Neyvia on your phone over your private network. Chats keep running on the PC.

chapters.title: Your decision
chapters.caption: Review requests that need permission. A browser human check pauses the agent and opens the live page for you.

chapters.title: Make it yours
chapters.caption: Settings → Look changes fonts, text size and backgrounds. Readability controls keep your text clear.

chapters.title: Apps anywhere
chapters.caption: Use the title-bar controls or drag an app beside chat, into a side panel, full screen or a bubble. Its open state stays with it.

chapters.title: Find this again
chapters.caption: Press Ctrl Space and type tour or settings. The tour of what makes Neyvia different is under Help.
